title.value: Berlin Mathematical School (BMS) PhD Program, 2027 admission
title.evidence_quote: For admission to our program in 2027, applications will be accepted via our online portal from 1 October to 1 December 2026 (first round) 1 March to 1 April 2027 (second round).

qualifications: Phase I: bachelor's degree completed by summer 2027
Recommendation letters due one week after the application deadline
description_short: The Berlin Mathematical School accepts 2027 applications: Phase I (master's studies) for bachelor's graduates and Phase II (doctoral research) for master's graduates. First round closes 1 December 2026, with 10 Phase I places with scholarship; second round runs to 1 April 2027.

deadline.evidence_quote: Phase I (Master studies): Deadline for application requiring admission with scholarship: 1 December 2026 Number of available places with scholarship: 10
